meta.title: Contractor worker drowned at an overflowing return-water dam
meta.location: Ridgeview Vanadium Mine (fictional), north return-water dam and pump installation
meta.rules:
Look at the problem, not at blaming people.
One person talks at a time.
Every idea goes on the diagram first. We test ideas later.
Say how you know: facts beat opinions.
Off-topic points go to the parking lot.

problem.what: A contractor worker drowned during an attempt to recover flooded pumps by boat
problem.where: North return-water dam and pump installation, Ridgeview Vanadium Mine (fictional)
problem.extent: 1 fatality (Worker A); Worker B reached the bank
problem.expected: No one is put at risk on the water to save equipment; work on water is planned, with life jackets and rescue at hand
problem.effect: Contractor worker drowned at the dam

facts.text: On 13 and 14 February heavy rain fell in the upper catchment of the north return-water dam.
About 14:30 the inflow raised the dam level quickly and the dam overflowed at the spillway. The pump installation at the dam was flooded.
About 14:50 the control room operator saw the pump installation flooding and called the engineering manager. The control room noticed only when the pumps were flooding.
The engineering manager asked the owner of a civils contractor on site to help recover the pumps.
The owner brought three workers with no experience of work on water.
About 15:20 two of the workers went out on the dam in an old boat that had stood unused behind the pump station for years. The third worker held a line from the bank.
About 15:30 the current and wind carried the boat towards the spillway, and the line was pulled from the shore attendant's hands.
About 15:35, afraid of going over the wall, both workers left the boat to swim to the bank.
Worker B reached the bank. Worker A, who could not swim, went under and drowned (about 15:40).
There was no risk assessment or job plan for the work.
There were no life jackets and no rescue equipment at the dam.
The workers had no training for work on water.
About 17:30 police divers recovered the body of Worker A.
